newsitem.title: UK: European cotton market ends week firmer.
newsitem.headline: European cotton market ends week firmer.

text.p: Asking prices for most upland raw cottons ended the week firmer following the recovery by New York futures, industry sources said on Friday.
But sentiment among mill buyers in most of Europe was little changed, with spinners continuing to cover only pressing needs.
The long staple market has been assessing the interest generated by Egypt's opening prices, announced last weekend.

The volume of bids submitted to Alexandria should be known early next week, but initial indications are for a subdued response. Attention has also focused on the level of offers of U.S. Pima, which promises to offer serious competition.
